sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, centroid x/y) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/princess/grand-princess/v4/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one <path class="cabin-shape" data-cabin> per stateroom. As with all Princess deckmaps SVGs (contrast Royal Caribbean), category is NOT encoded in colour: every cabin path is fill="#fff" with a black stroke over a monochrome background raster. Category was derived by spatially registering each deckmaps cabin centroid against the category-coded HTML image-map regions (<area title="Category XX ...">) on cruisedeckplans.com's Grand-Princess per-deck plans. Those regions are contiguous category BANDS (one rectangle per same-category block per side), not per-cabin. Registration is per-deck, side-partitioned (even=port/odd=starboard confirmed against geometry), with per-column linear y-registration so a cabin inherits the category of the band covering its fractional position along its column. Category-code legend (IA-IF Interior; OC/OF/OE Oceanview; OV/OW/OY/OZ Oceanview-Obstructed; O3 Deluxe Oceanview; BA-BF Balcony; B2/B4 Premium Balcony; MB/MD/ME/M1 Mini-Suite; S1-S8 suites) taken from cruisedeckplans category tooltips. Validated against cruisedeckplans' 27 listed accessible/known-cabin anchors: 25/27 (93%) exact sub-code, 27/27 (100%) marketing group.

notes.completeness: FULL geometry grid: all 1301 staterooms across the 8 guest decks (5,6,8,9,10,11,12,14). Per-deck counts (5:92, 6:7, 8:184, 9:203, 10:256, 11:263, 12:231, 14:65) come straight from the deckmaps cabin-shape paths; no cabin number was invented, every number+position is parsed directly from the SVGs. 1301 is an excellent match to Grand Princess's real published stateroom count (~1,300). Decks 7 (Promenade), 13, 15+ carry no staterooms in the deckmaps source. Cabin numbers are Grand-class alphanumeric (deck-letter prefix: P=Plaza 5, F=Fiesta 6, E=Emerald 8, D=Dolphin 9, C=Caribe 10, B=Baja 11, A=Aloha 12, R=Riviera 14).
notes.category: APPROXIMATE / DERIVED, not from the geometry source. Princess deckmaps SVGs carry no category colour (all fills #fff), so categories were assigned by spatially matching each cabin to cruisedeckplans.com's category-coded band regions, then collapsing the fine Princess sub-codes to marketing groups (Interior; Oceanview; Deluxe Oceanview; Balcony; Premium Balcony; Mini-Suite; Suite). Internal validation against cruisedeckplans' 27 known-cabin anchors: 25/27 (93%) correct at sub-code level and 27/27 (100%) at marketing-group level. Accuracy is highest inside contiguous category blocks and lowest at block boundaries and on the sparsely-banded Plaza (5) and Fiesta (6) decks (a few cabins assigned by nearest-band fallback). Emerald Deck 8 is predominantly obstructed-view oceanview (lifeboat deck), correctly captured once the obstructed OV/OW/OY/OZ band regions were included. Treat individual-cabin category as a strong estimate, not a booking-grade guarantee.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Bow direction confirmed at the TOP (low y) of every deck SVG: cabin number correlates with y at +0.96..+0.99 across all 8 decks, so low numbers/low y = forward. section = forward/mid/aft thirds of each deck's occupied length. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED from Princess cabin-number parity (even=port, odd=starboard), the Princess convention. Cross-checked against geometry: on every deck EVERY even cabin sits at low x and every odd cabin at high x in the deckmaps SVG, so port=low-x and the parity rule and the drawn plan agree (the plan is NOT mirrored). High confidence for this hull.
notes.obstructed: Per-cabin obstruction IS encoded here, unusually: cruisedeckplans marks 136 cabins with obstructed-view oceanview codes (OV/OW/OY/OZ), almost all on Emerald Deck 8, and those are flagged obstructed=true; every other cabin is obstructed=false. Note this is category-code-derived obstruction (subject to the same ~93% registration accuracy), not a per-window survey.
notes.sisterLayoutVariant: CAUTION: this file is the Grand Princess ORIGINAL hull. The Grand class spans layout variants across its sisters (Caribbean/Crown/Emerald/Ruby Princess, and the stretched Diamond/Sapphire Princess). Deck letters, cabin counts, category placement and even which decks carry staterooms differ between hulls. Do NOT reuse this grid blindly for a sister ship - each needs its own deckmaps + cruisedeckplans per-hull verification.

colorLegend.#fff: No category encoding. Princess deckmaps deck SVGs render every cabin shape as white fill (#fff) with a black stroke over a monochrome background raster; category is NOT conveyed by colour (contrast Royal Caribbean). Category in this file was derived externally from cruisedeckplans.com - see sourceDetail/notes.
